<script type="text/javascript">
    P.when('A', 'dm-common-helpers', 'dm-common-utils', 'dm-common-account', 'dm-button-redirect').execute(function(A, helpers, utils, account, redirect) {

        // Emit uiPageView after page has been loaded
        window.onload = function() {
            sendUiPageView();
        }

        if (document.readyState !== 'loading') {
            initListeners();
        } else {
            document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
                initListeners();
            });
        }

        function initListeners() {
            // Emit uiClick on Try it free/Play now buttons click
            var musicLandingButtons = document.querySelectorAll(".dmusic_landing_button");
            musicLandingButtons.forEach(function(button, index) {
                button.addEventListener("click", async function(event) {
                    //Logic for forms buttons
                    const actionType = button.closest('[widget-action-type]')?.getAttribute('widget-action-type') || "goCta";
                    if (event.currentTarget.parentElement.type === 'submit') {
                        var validForm = event.currentTarget.closest('form:valid');
                        if (validForm) {
                            event.preventDefault();
                            await sendUiClick(actionType, "CLICK", button.textContent.trim(),
                                utils.getElementPosition(index));
                            var currentAction = validForm.action;
                            var formData = new FormData(validForm);
                            var params = new URLSearchParams(formData);
                            // Check if URL already has parameters
                            var connector = currentAction.includes('?') ? '&' : '?';
                            // Combine URLs
                            var finalURL = currentAction + connector + params.toString();
                            var redirectData = {isListenNowButton: false, url:  finalURL}
                            redirect.landingButtonRedirect(event, redirectData, validForm);
                        } else {
                            await sendUiClick("tryCTA", "CLICK", button.textContent.trim(),
                                utils.getElementPosition(index));
                        }
                        return;
                    }

                    event.preventDefault();
                    //Get the first anchor tag in the current span
                    var anchorElement = event.currentTarget.getElementsByTagName("a")[0];
                    // Parse the json data present in data-button attribute
                    var buttonData = JSON.parse(anchorElement.dataset.button);
                    if (buttonData.isListenNowButton) {
                        // This is done to replace text generated by the play icon
                        await sendUiClick(actionType, "CLICK", button.textContent.replace("Play icon", "").trim(), utils.getElementPosition(index));
                    } else {
                        await sendUiClick(actionType, "CLICK", button.textContent.trim(), utils.getElementPosition(index));
                        if (helpers.notEmpty(account.sendFeedbackEndpoint) && account.pageSubType === "uber-landing") {
                            await sendFeedback("subscription");
                        }
                    }
                    redirect.landingButtonRedirect(event, buttonData, anchorElement);
                });
            })

            // Emit uiClick on link container items click
            var musicLinkItems = document.querySelectorAll(".music .link-container");
            musicLinkItems.forEach(function(linkItem, index){
                linkItem.addEventListener("click", async function(event) {
                    const actionType = linkItem.closest('[data-widget-action-type]')?.getAttribute("data-widget-action-type");
                    if (actionType) {
                        await sendUiClick(actionType, "CLICK", "", utils.getElementPosition(index));
                    }
                })
            })

            // Emit uiClick on Nav bar items hover & click
            var navBarItems = document.querySelectorAll("#nav-subnav .nav-a:link");
            navBarItems.forEach(function(navBarItem) {
                navBarItem.addEventListener("mouseenter", async function(event) {
                    let text = navBarItem.textContent.trim();
                    // Emit uiClick hover on non empty nav bar elements
                    if (helpers.notEmpty(text)) {
                        await sendUiClick("selectMenu", "HOVER", text, "header");
                    }
                })
                navBarItem.addEventListener("click", async function(event) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    if(navBarItem.classList.contains("nav-hasImage")) {
                        // Emit uiClick on Amazon Music Logo click
                        await sendUiClick("selectLogo", "CLICK", "amazon music", "header");
                    } else {
                        // Emit uiClick on remaining nav bar items
                        var text = navBarItem.textContent.trim();
                        if (helpers.notEmpty(text)) {
                            if (navBarItem.querySelector(".nav-image") !== null) {
                                // Go Web Player item is being clicked
                                await sendUiClick("goWebPlayer", "CLICK", text, "header");
                            } else {
                                await sendUiClick("selectMenu", "CLICK", text, "header");
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    utils.landingElementRedirect(navBarItem);
                })
            })

            // Emit uiClick on underlined text click
            // Example: Amazon Music Unlimited
            var underlinedText = document.querySelectorAll(".music .text a:link");
            underlinedText.forEach(function(textItem) {
                textItem.addEventListener("click", async function(event) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    var text = textItem.textContent.trim();
                    if (helpers.notEmpty(text)) {
                        await sendUiClick("goStore", "CLICK", text, "body");
                    }
                    utils.landingElementRedirect(textItem);
                })
            })

            // Emit uiClick on additional text click
            // Example: See more (spatial/why-hd)
            var seeMoreText = document.querySelectorAll(".music .link-type-primary:link");
            seeMoreText.forEach(function(textItem) {
                textItem.addEventListener("click", async function(event) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    var promoText = textItem.textContent.trim();
                    var url = textItem.getAttribute("href");
                    // Appending spatial/HD to capture the text as See More spatial / See More HD
                    if (url.indexOf("why-hd?view=spatial-audio") !== -1) {
                        promoText += " spatial";
                    } else if(url.indexOf("why-hd") !== -1) {
                        promoText += " HD";
                    }
                    await sendUiClick("goPromo", "CLICK", promoText, "body");
                    utils.landingElementRedirect(textItem);
                })
            })

            // Emit uiClick on RecommendationsRow widget clicked and alter on-hover styling.
            // Style changes are temporary fixes and will be moved over to LEGO side on productionization.
            var recommendationItems = document.querySelectorAll(".recommendation_item_container");
            recommendationItems.forEach(function (recommendation) {
                recommendation.addEventListener('mouseover', () => {
                    recommendation.style.opacity = 0.3;
                    recommendation.style.transition = "0.5s ease";
                });
                recommendation.addEventListener('mouseout', () => {
                    recommendation.style.opacity = 1;
                    recommendation.style.transition = "0.5s ease";
                });
                recommendation.addEventListener("click", async function(event) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    var anchorElement = event.currentTarget.getElementsByTagName("a")[0];
                    var buttonData = JSON.parse(anchorElement.dataset.button);

                    await sendUiClick("recommendationWidgetClicked", "CLICK", "", "");
                    redirect.landingButtonRedirect(event, buttonData, anchorElement);
                })
            })

            const emailOptOutPage = document.getElementById('email-opt-out');
            if (emailOptOutPage) {
                emailOptOutPage.addEventListener('unsubscribeSuccess', async function(event) {
                    await sendUiPageView('unsubscribeSuccess');
                });
                emailOptOutPage.addEventListener('unsubscribeAllSuccess', async function(event) {
                    await sendUiPageView('unsubscribeAllSuccess');
                });
                emailOptOutPage.addEventListener('unsubscribeFailure', async function(event) {
                    await sendUiPageView('unsubscribeFailure');
                });
                emailOptOutPage.addEventListener('unsubscribeAllFailure', async function(event) {
                    await sendUiPageView('unsubscribeAllFailure');
                });
            }
        }

        function uiPageViewRequestBody(pageType) {
            var now = new Date();
            var uiPageViewRequest = {
                deviceType : account.deviceType,
                deviceId : account.deviceId,
                customerId : account.customerId,
                clientActionList : [{
                    actionName: "uiPageView",
                    timestamp: now.getTime(),
                    additionalDetails: {
                        // Value assigned by metrix team to identify music landing pages
                        productId : "802",
                        baseEventVersion : "4",
                        specificEventVersion : "5",
                        appVersion: "1.0",
                        eventName : "uiPageView",
                        serviceEventId : helpers.uuidv4(),
                        clientTimestamp : now.toISOString(),
                        marketplaceId : account.marketplaceId,
                        deviceTimeZone : helpers.getTimezoneOffset(),
                        musicTerritory : account.musicTerritory,
                        clientIpAddress: account.clientIpAddress,
                        userAgent : account.userAgent,
                        pageType : pageType ?? utils.getPageType(window.location.hostname),
                        pageSubType : account.pageSubType,
                        url : window.location.href,
                        csSessionId : account.csSessionId,
                        referer : account.referer,
                        associateTag : account.associateTag,
                        refMarker : account.refMarker,
                        placementId : account.placementId
                    }
                }]
            };
            return uiPageViewRequest;
        }

        function uiClickRequestBody(actionType, interactionType, itemText, contentName) {
            var uiClickViewRequest = uiPageViewRequestBody();
            uiClickViewRequest.clientActionList[0].additionalDetails.specificEventVersion = "6";
            uiClickViewRequest.clientActionList[0].actionName = "uiClick";
            uiClickViewRequest.clientActionList[0].additionalDetails.eventName = "uiClick";
            uiClickViewRequest.clientActionList[0].additionalDetails.eventType = "uiClick";
            uiClickViewRequest.clientActionList[0].additionalDetails.actionType = actionType;
            uiClickViewRequest.clientActionList[0].additionalDetails.interactionType = interactionType;
            uiClickViewRequest.clientActionList[0].additionalDetails.itemText = itemText;
            var contentInfo = [{
                contentSrc : "client",
                contentName : contentName
            }]
            uiClickViewRequest.clientActionList[0].contentInfo = contentInfo;

            return uiClickViewRequest;
        }

        async function sendUiPageView(pageType) {
            if (account.csSessionId !== "000-0000000-0000000") {
                try {
                    var endpoint = account.cirrusEndpoint;
                    var response = await fetch(endpoint, {
                        method: "POST",
                        credentials: "include",
                        headers: getHeaders(),
                        body: JSON.stringify(uiPageViewRequestBody(pageType))
                    });
                    if (!response.ok) {
                        throw new Error("Cirrus request failed with status " + response.status + " " + response.statusText);
                    }
                    console.log("uiPageView: event submitted");
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error("uiPageView response error:", error);
                }
            }
        }

        async function sendUiClick(actionType, interactionType, itemText, contentName) {
            if (account.csSessionId !== "000-0000000-0000000") {
                try {
                    var endpoint = account.cirrusEndpoint;
                    var response = fetch(endpoint, {
                        method: "POST",
                        credentials: "include",
                        headers: getHeaders(),
                        body: JSON.stringify(uiClickRequestBody(actionType, interactionType, itemText, contentName))
                    });
                    // Wait 1 second for Cirrus Response or abort and proceed to redirect
                    var timeoutPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            resolve(null);
                        }, 1000);
                    });
                    var result = await Promise.race([response, timeoutPromise]);
                    if (!result) {
                        throw new Error("Cirrus request failed due to timeout");
                    } else {
                        if (!result.ok) {
                            throw new Error("Cirrus request failed with status " + result.status + " " + result.statusText);
                        }
                        console.log("uiClick: event submitted");
                    }
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error("uiClick response error:", error);
                }
            }
        }

        function getHeaders () {
            return {
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
                "X-Amz-Target": "com.amazon.cirrus.libraryservice.v3.CirrusLibraryServiceExternalV3.reportClientActions",
                "Content-Encoding": "amz-1.0",
                "csrf-token": account.csrfToken,
                "csrf-rnd": account.csrfRandom,
                "csrf-ts": account.csrfTimestamp
            };
        }

        function sendFeedbackRequestBody(ctaType) {
            var sendFeedbackRequestRequest = {
                eventId : account.eventId,
                experimentId : account.experimentId,
                actionKey : account.actionId,
                ctaType : ctaType,
            };
            return sendFeedbackRequestRequest;
        }

        function getFeedbackHeaders () {
            return {
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
                "Content-Encoding": "amz-1.0",
            };
        }

        async function sendFeedback(actionType) {
            try {
                A.$.ajax({
                    type: "POST",
                    headers: getFeedbackHeaders(),
                    xhrFields: {
                        withCredentials: true,
                    },
                    data: JSON.stringify(sendFeedbackRequestBody(actionType)),
                    url: account.sendFeedbackEndpoint,
                });
            } catch (error) {
                console.error("sendFeedback error:", error);
            }
        }

    });
